spreadsheet.game_name: Donkey Kong Country 2: Diddy's Kong Quest

changelog: * Added a `configure_server` script to the SAWS folder to help easily set up mod settings for the server.
* Prevented webhost from serving an incorrectly renamed mod file.
* Updated SAWS Client to use an isolated config folder.  This allows you to use the same Factorio executable for both server and client.
* Saves and Mods now go in the `factorio_saws` folder in your archipelago folder.
* This is a port of my PR for vanilla Factorio at https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/pull/4221, hopefully it merges there in time for AP 0.6.4 🙂

changelog: Added the 7.4 MSQ dungeon and trial
Added new setting to only select a random subset of all duties from an expansion (ie, only a handful of ARR dungeons instead of all of them)
Added new setting to add extra checks for completing dungeons
Fixed bug with `max_party_size` setting not being applied correctly
Fixed crash when a shop contains a deprioritized item. Added backwards compatibility for worlds created before area_domination added.
